events.role: Soft, low, tactile contacts with very little ring
events.prompt: One isolated soft contact between two small matte stoneware animal figurines. A rounded woody ceramic tick with restrained resonance, warm low-mid body, and a very short natural decay. Close dry studio recording, exactly one impact, no room sound.

events.role: Rounded ceramic clacks with a short hollow body
events.prompt: One isolated gentle clack between two small thick-walled glazed earthenware animal figurines. A tactile ceramic attack with a warm rounded hollow body, subtle pitch, and a short natural decay. Close dry studio recording, exactly one impact, no room sound.

events.role: Small, bright contacts with a clean delicate ring
events.prompt: One isolated light touch between two small thin-walled porcelain animal figurines. A crisp bright ceramic click with a clean delicate pitched ring and a brief natural decay. Close dry studio recording, exactly one impact, no room sound.
